summary: Iter 29 both fixes verified GREEN end-to-end. Backend PUT/GET persistence + tenant isolation + validators all pass (6/6 pytest). Frontend Settings save re-syncs normalized whatsapp instantly, persists across hard reload, and stays tenant-isolated. TenantBrandMark sidebar shows correct per-tenant name+location for both salons.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx saveBranding: response-driven re-sync is correct and safe — spreads over previous state so missing server keys don't wipe local fields.

TenantBrandMark subtitle uses `truncate` on the location line — long single-word locations may still be clipped visually, but the current 'MARATHAHALLI, BANGALORE' and 'KORAMANGALA, BANGALORE' fit without clipping. Not blocking.

server.py PUT /settings/branding returns spread of update dict — safe because BrandingIn.model_dump(exclude_none=True) already strips None values and the normalized whatsapp_number comes back as digits-only string. Tenant scoping is enforced via require_tenant_admin → current_tenant → update by t['id']. Isolation verified in both pytest and Playwright (miracurl values untouched after Elegance PUT).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter29 items ALL GREEN. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_iter29_settings_persist_and_tenantbrand.py — 6 tests in a SINGLE class (grouped intentionally so pytest-xdist LoadScope keeps them on one worker in deterministic order). If you split them into multiple classes you'll hit a race with the baseline-restore step running before the tenant-isolation assertion. Frontend Playwright: MUST wait for settings-location to have a non-empty value before filling settings-phone — otherwise the initial GET /settings/branding fetch overwrites the fill (I hit this race on the first attempt). TenantBrandMark data-testid=tenant-brand-mark renders correctly for both tenants; screenshot confirms 'Miracurl Unisex Family Salon' + 'MARATHAHALLI, BANGALORE' in the sidebar (replaces old static MIRACURL/SALON SUITE logo). Dashboard heading and Daily Report banner both use tenant.name — no 'Miracurl' hardcode leak for Elegance.
